blocks.text: Interior design, custom furniture manufacturing, and turnkey renovation

parts.html: My name is Irina Dumskaya, and I am delighted to welcome you to the world of unique and innovative interior design by DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia). Our mission is to turn your space into a true reflection of your style, comfort, and ambitions. In every project, we strive not only to create a beautiful interior but also to bring a part of your personality into it, so that you feel truly at home there every day.

In our work, we combine a creative approach with technical precision so that our projects are not only aesthetically appealing but also functional. We take pride in listening carefully to our clients and turning their dreams into reality. Whether you are planning a cozy family home or a stylish commercial space, my team and I are ready to offer solutions that will exceed your expectations.

The DUMSKAYA DESIGN studio (Bratislava, Slovakia) develops interior design projects complete with turnkey renovation and furniture manufacturing for apartments, detached houses, townhouses, private country homes, villas, hotels, offices, stores, and beauty salons.
I look forward to the opportunity to work with you and create something truly unique.
Studio Director and Principal Designer, DUMSKAYA DESIGN
What do you get when you commission a design from DUMSKAYA DESIGN?

items: Unique solutions that reflect your style and way of life.
All your wishes and needs taken into account.
Measured floor plan of the space.
Plans for plumbing fixtures, underfloor heating, outlets, and switches.
A complete list of finishing materials and their quantities.
The option to make revisions to achieve the perfect result.
Design supervision to oversee the project’s implementation.
From concept to completion — we take on every stage of the project, including the development of furniture drawings and sections.
Professional oversight at every stage of the project.
Saving time and avoiding costly mistakes.

parts.html: When you commission a design from DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia), you get more than an interior — you get a space that reflects your individuality and brings you joy every day.
